followup_checklist_damage_limit.name: followup_checklist_damage_limit
followup_checklist_damage_limit.value: ("followup_checklist_items"."counted" IS NULL AND "followup_checklist_items"."damaged"=0) OR ("followup_checklist_items"."counted" IS NOT NULL AND "followup_checklist_items"."damaged"<="followup_checklist_items"."counted")

followup_task_references.name: followup_task_references
followup_task_references.value: "followup_tasks"."project_id" IS NOT NULL OR ("followup_tasks"."campaign_id" IS NULL AND "followup_tasks"."item_id" IS NULL AND "followup_tasks"."loan_id" IS NULL)

items_acquisition_value_check.name: items_acquisition_value_check
items_acquisition_value_check.value: "items"."acquisition_value_cents" IS NULL OR (typeof("items"."acquisition_value_cents")='integer' AND "items"."acquisition_value_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000)

projects_interval_check.name: projects_interval_check
projects_interval_check.value: "projects"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "projects"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "projects"."ends_at" > "projects"."starts_at"

records_interval_check.name: records_interval_check
records_interval_check.value: "records"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "records"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "records"."ends_at" >= "records"."starts_at"
